At SARETY, our vision is to design and build innovative financial market tools that bridge the research gap between large institutional investors and retail participants.

We believe high-quality financial research, analytical tools, and market intelligence should not be exclusive to institutions. Our mission is to democratize financial research by making institutional-grade intelligence accessible, understandable, and actionable for everyone.

A SARETY PRODUCT

At EQ-T, our vision is to bridge the equity research gap between institutional investors and retail participants.

We believe every investor deserves access to the insights, data, and research capabilities needed to make informed investment decisions.

Our Mission

To democratize equity research through intelligent technology, making complex financial information understandable, actionable, and accessible to all.

KEY FOCUS AREAS

  • Equity Research & Forensic Accounting
  • AI & RAG for Financial Filings
  • Smart Charts for Traders
  • Research coverage of NIFTY50 firms on EQ-T.com.

MILESTONES

  • Launched SARETY and EQ-T (MVP in progress)
  • Accepted into NVIDIA Inception Program
  • Part of Genesis Incubator, Quantum University

ABOUT THE FOUNDER

An investor. A developer. A builder at the intersection of finance and technology.

He is pursuing a Diploma in Programming & Data Science from IIT Madras alongside his third year of B.Tech in Data Science at Quantum University, Roorkee.

His work focuses on the intersection of financial markets, software engineering, and data science, with a particular interest in systematic investing, financial analytics, and AI-driven equity research.
